out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. BEFORE INSPECTION, OBSERVED AMENDMENT FROM 3/2026 WAITING FOR CORRECTIONS FOR CHANGE OF EQUIPMENT.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: DURING THE INSPECTION, PIC SENT IN CORRECTIONS FOR AMENDMENT INCLUDING BUILDING PERMIT, NONRUP, AND FIRE PERMIT.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The following farm-raised fish served raw or partially cooked were observed without a written statement from the supplier stating that the fish were raised and fed according to 3-402.11(B)(3). OBSERVED SMOKED SALMON IN FACILITY AND PIC DID NOT HAVE A LETTER INDICATED IT WAS FARM RAISED, PELLET FED OR FROZEN FOR PARASITE DESTRUCTION.
violations.corrective_action: Contact your fish supplier and ask for a written statement stating that the fish were raised in net pens if in open water OR land-based operations AND fed formulated feed that contains no live parasites. FAX a copy of this letter to your inspector and keep this statement on site at the food establishment for 90 days beyond the time of service of the fish. CDI: PIC REMOVED SALMON FROM MENU AND FACILITY DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: smoked salmon
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. CDI: SMOKED SALMON REMOVED FROM MENU AND FROM RESTAURANT DURING INSPECTION. PIC AGREED TO NOT SERVICE RAW FOOD ITEM.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED ESPRESSO CLEANER STORED WITH COFFEE FLAVORING ON A SHELF NEAR COOKLINE.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: CLEANER RELOCATED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. Both handwashing sinks did not have a a handwashing poster
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC agreed to replace the handwashing sinks

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: salt, sugar and flour container were not properly labeled
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC agreed to label food

violations.title: Maintenance Tools Storage
violations.observation: Maintenance tools are not being stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single-service items. Facility is currently under renovations, maintenance tools are not being stored in a designated area
violations.corrective_action: Store all maintenance tools in a manner that prevents contamination of food and food-contact surfaces. PIC agreed to move maintenance tools to designated storage area

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises. PIC has maintenance and renovation equipment stored around the facility and not contained
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. PIC agreed to organize and clean the facility.

violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees.
